title: Learned-projector QAOA for hierarchical optimization
summary: Many optimization problems reveal inexpensive structural information before requiring costly final evaluation, whereas the conventional quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) applies a single aggregate objective throughout. We introduce the learned-projector quantum alternating operator ansatz (LP-QAOA), a multistage protocol that freezes optimized circuits and uses their output states to define later projector mixers.
